# Markdown in Sumi

Text can be *italic*, **bold**, ***both***, ~~struck~~ or `code`;
links go [to the docs](https://aizome.org/docs) or <https://sekka.dev>.

> A quote, with *emphasis* in it.

1. Numbered
2. Items
- [x] tiles at fractional scale
- [ ] tiles under rotation

```rust
pub struct Tile {
    pub rect: Rect,
    pub dirty: bool, // since the last present
}
```
